protocol.routing: Exact status and module match; clarification is a separate expected outcome, not a successful module route. Report overall and supported-only.
protocol.requiredFields: Micro average over predefined required fields that have explicit or null expectations. Null is correct only if field is present and null. Also report complete-case eligibility separately.
protocol.actionSuccess: All frozen field checks AND Android target screen entry using the recorded real-model response. Clarifications scored separately. Does not claim each record was saved; user confirmation and persistence are separate reliability checks.
protocol.latency: Sequential local inference plus backend validation, nearest-rank P50/P95, excluding warmup and Android UI. One run per case; no CI or statistical significance claims.
protocol.title: Predeclared keyword checks, not full semantic equivalence.
protocol.limitations: Newly authored internal held-out evaluation, not externally independent. Some bilingual cases are paired and correlated. Never used for tuning before this run; once inspected, reuse is regression only.
